quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: beyond vs past
quests.question: The negotiations continued well ___ the agreed deadline, frustrating everyone involved.
quests.targetSentence: The negotiations continued well past the agreed deadline, frustrating everyone involved.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Past' fits moving by a specific point in time, like a deadline; 'beyond' would suit a more general limit or scope.
quests.nativeTip: A deadline is a specific point in time being moved by, not a general limit being extended.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'past' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The negotiations continued well past the agreed deadline, frustrating everyone involved.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: beyond vs past
quests.question: Her ambition extends far ___ simply running her own department — she wants to lead the entire division.
quests.targetSentence: Her ambition extends far beyond simply running her own department — she wants to lead the entire division.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beyond' fits an abstract scope extending further than a limit, distinct from 'past', which suits specific points.
quests.nativeTip: This describes a general scope extending further than a starting point, not a specific point in time.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'beyond' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Her ambition extends far beyond simply running her own department — she wants to lead the entire division.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: beyond vs past
quests.question: The bridge was built to withstand pressures ___ what engineers initially thought necessary.
quests.targetSentence: The bridge was built to withstand pressures beyond what engineers initially thought necessary.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beyond' fits again, describing pressures exceeding an original expectation significantly.
quests.nativeTip: This describes exceeding an expectation by a wide margin, the same pattern taught earlier in this course.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'beyond' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The bridge was built to withstand pressures beyond what engineers initially thought necessary.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: amid vs among
quests.question: The proposal received support ___ several key stakeholders, though not unanimous.
quests.targetSentence: The proposal received support among several key stakeholders, though not unanimous.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Among' fits a countable group of stakeholders, unlike 'amid', which is reserved for uncountable atmospheres.
quests.nativeTip: This is a specific, countable group of people.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'among' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The proposal received support among several key stakeholders, though not unanimous.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: amid vs among
quests.question: The city continued its slow recovery ___ ongoing economic uncertainty.
quests.targetSentence: The city continued its slow recovery amid ongoing economic uncertainty.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Amid' fits an abstract, uncountable atmosphere, like ongoing economic uncertainty.
quests.nativeTip: This is an abstract, uncountable atmosphere surrounding a situation.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'amid' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The city continued its slow recovery amid ongoing economic uncertainty.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: amid vs among
quests.question: Rumors circulated ___ the staff about upcoming layoffs.
quests.targetSentence: Rumors circulated among the staff about upcoming layoffs.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Among' fits a group of people something spreads through, here the staff.
quests.nativeTip: This is a group of people the rumors spread through, not a general atmosphere.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'among' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Rumors circulated among the staff about upcoming layoffs.'

quests.question: The manuscript, discovered ___ a stack of old newspapers, turned out to be worth a fortune.
quests.targetSentence: The manuscript, discovered underneath a stack of old newspapers, turned out to be worth a fortune.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Underneath' describes something physically beneath an object, distinct from 'alongside', which would mean beside it.
quests.nativeTip: This describes something physically beneath a pile, not beside it.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'underneath' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The manuscript, discovered underneath a stack of old newspapers, turned out to be worth a fortune.'

quests.question: The two artists have been developing their signature styles ___ each other for over a decade.
quests.targetSentence: The two artists have been developing their signature styles alongside each other for over a decade.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Alongside' describes parallel development between peers, distinct from 'underneath', which would suggest physical concealment.
quests.nativeTip: This describes parallel development as peers, not one hidden beneath the other.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'alongside' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The two artists have been developing their signature styles alongside each other for over a decade.'

quests.question: Hidden ___ layers of bureaucracy, the original proposal had been almost entirely forgotten.
quests.targetSentence: Hidden underneath layers of bureaucracy, the original proposal had been almost entirely forgotten.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Underneath' is used figuratively here, describing something buried beneath layers of process.
quests.nativeTip: This is a figurative version of the physical word for beneath, applied to something buried in process.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'underneath' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Hidden underneath layers of bureaucracy, the original proposal had been almost entirely forgotten.'

quests.question: The two companies had been fierce competitors for over twenty years, ___ the merger.
quests.targetSentence: The two companies had been fierce competitors for over twenty years, prior to the merger.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Prior to' describes the period before an event, the formal equivalent of 'before'.
quests.nativeTip: This describes the period before an event, in formal register.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'prior to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The two companies had been fierce competitors for over twenty years, prior to the merger.'

quests.question: Morale across the company remained surprisingly high, ___ several rounds of layoffs.
quests.targetSentence: Morale across the company remained surprisingly high, following several rounds of layoffs.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Following' describes the period after an event, the formal equivalent of 'after'.
quests.nativeTip: This describes the period after a difficult event, in formal register.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'following' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Morale across the company remained surprisingly high, following several rounds of layoffs.'

quests.question: The company issued a formal statement ___ the investigation's conclusion.
quests.targetSentence: The company issued a formal statement following the investigation's conclusion.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Following' fits again here, describing an action taken after an event concluded.
quests.nativeTip: This describes an action taken right after an event concluded, matching the earlier example.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'following' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The company issued a formal statement following the investigation's conclusion.'

quests.question: The plan proceeded smoothly, ___ a brief delay at the final stage.
quests.targetSentence: The plan proceeded smoothly, with the exception of a brief delay at the final stage.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'With the exception of' names the one case that breaks an otherwise general statement.
quests.nativeTip: This names the one thing that breaks an otherwise smooth process.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with the exception of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The plan proceeded smoothly, with the exception of a brief delay at the final stage.'

quests.question: The CEO moved forward with the acquisition, ___ any objections from the board.
quests.targetSentence: The CEO moved forward with the acquisition, in the absence of any objections from the board.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In the absence of' shows that no objections existed at all, distinct from naming a specific exception.
quests.nativeTip: This describes acting when opposition simply doesn't exist, not naming an exception.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in the absence of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The CEO moved forward with the acquisition, in the absence of any objections from the board.'

quests.question: The team hit its targets every month this year, ___ a slow start in January.
quests.targetSentence: The team hit its targets every month this year, with the exception of a slow start in January.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'With the exception of' fits again, naming the one case that breaks an otherwise consistent record.
quests.nativeTip: This names the one month that breaks an otherwise perfect record.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with the exception of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The team hit its targets every month this year, with the exception of a slow start in January.'

quests.question: Passengers now had to deal with lost luggage as well, ___ the flight delay.
quests.targetSentence: Passengers now had to deal with lost luggage as well, on top of the flight delay.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'On top of' adds one more problem to an already difficult situation, here a flight delay.
quests.nativeTip: This adds one more problem to an already frustrating situation.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on top of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Passengers now had to deal with lost luggage as well, on top of the flight delay.'

quests.question: The factory increased output significantly, but only ___ worker safety standards.
quests.targetSentence: The factory increased output significantly, but only at the expense of worker safety standards.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'At the expense of' shows a gain achieved at the cost of something else, here safety standards.
quests.nativeTip: One goal was achieved while another important thing suffered.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'at the expense of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The factory increased output significantly, but only at the expense of worker safety standards.'

quests.question: The ancient message was preserved ___ careful oral tradition passed down through generations.
quests.targetSentence: The ancient message was preserved by means of careful oral tradition passed down through generations.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'By means of' introduces the specific method used to preserve something, here oral tradition.
quests.nativeTip: This introduces the specific method used to accomplish something.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'by means of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The ancient message was preserved by means of careful oral tradition passed down through generations.'

quests.question: The airline overhauled its safety protocols ___ the investigation's damning findings.
quests.targetSentence: The airline overhauled its safety protocols in the wake of the investigation's damning findings.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In the wake of' describes a change made as a direct aftermath of a significant event, here an investigation.
quests.nativeTip: This describes a major change made as a direct aftermath of a significant event.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in the wake of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The airline overhauled its safety protocols in the wake of the investigation's damning findings.'

quests.question: All refunds will be issued ___ the terms specified in the original contract.
quests.targetSentence: All refunds will be issued in accordance with the terms specified in the original contract.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In accordance with' shows compliance with formal terms, distinct from 'in the wake of', which describes reacting to a recent event.
quests.nativeTip: This shows an action following the rules of a formal document, not reacting to a recent event.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in accordance with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'All refunds will be issued in accordance with the terms specified in the original contract.'

quests.question: New hiring freezes were announced ___ the disappointing earnings report.
quests.targetSentence: New hiring freezes were announced in the wake of the disappointing earnings report.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In the wake of' fits again, describing a decision made as a direct reaction to a recent event.
quests.nativeTip: This describes a decision made as a direct reaction to a recent event.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in the wake of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'New hiring freezes were announced in the wake of the disappointing earnings report.'

quests.question: The evidence presented was insufficient to distinguish the defendant's account ___ that of the other witnesses.
quests.targetSentence: The evidence presented was insufficient to distinguish the defendant's account from that of the other witnesses.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Distinguish ... from' is the fixed idiom for telling two things apart by comparison.
quests.nativeTip: This introduces the thing being compared against in order to tell two things apart.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'from' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The evidence presented was insufficient to distinguish the defendant's account from that of the other witnesses.'

quests.question: The board's decision was heavily influenced ___ concerns about long-term profitability.
quests.targetSentence: The board's decision was heavily influenced by concerns about long-term profitability.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Influenced by' is the fixed idiom for naming the factor that shaped a decision.
quests.nativeTip: This introduces the factor that shaped a decision.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'by' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The board's decision was heavily influenced by concerns about long-term profitability.'

quests.question: Her thesis draws heavily ___ the work of several prominent sociologists.
quests.targetSentence: Her thesis draws heavily on the work of several prominent sociologists.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Draw on' is the fixed idiom for using existing work as a foundation or source.
quests.nativeTip: This links academic work to the sources it's built from.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'Her thesis draws heavily on the work of several prominent sociologists.'

quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: Although the two treaties differ significantly ___ their scope, they share a common underlying philosophy.
quests.targetSentence: Although the two treaties differ significantly in their scope, they share a common underlying philosophy.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Differ in' names the specific respect of divergence, the verb-form pattern taught earlier in this course.
quests.nativeTip: This names the specific respect in which two things diverge, as taught earlier in this course.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'Although the two treaties differ significantly in their scope, they share a common underlying philosophy.'

quests.question: The final decision rests ___ the board chair, though several members have expressed strong opinions.
quests.targetSentence: The final decision rests with the board chair, though several members have expressed strong opinions.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Rests with' returns here, showing where ultimate authority belongs despite differing opinions.
quests.nativeTip: This is the fixed idiom for saying where ultimate authority belongs, taught earlier in this course.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The final decision rests with the board chair, though several members have expressed strong opinions.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: beyond vs past
quests.question: Property values have climbed to levels far ___ what analysts had predicted for this region.
quests.targetSentence: Property values have climbed to levels far beyond what analysts had predicted for this region.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beyond' fits exceeding a prediction significantly, the same pattern taught earlier with unexpected outcomes.
quests.nativeTip: This describes exceeding a prediction by a wide margin, the same pattern taught earlier for expectations.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'beyond' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Property values have climbed to levels far beyond what analysts had predicted for this region.'

quests.question: The charity relies ___ donations from the public to fund its operations, receiving little government support.
quests.targetSentence: The charity relies on donations from the public to fund its operations, receiving little government support.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Rely on' closes this idea, linking the charity's dependence to public donations.
quests.nativeTip: This links dependence to the thing being counted on, as taught throughout this course.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'The charity relies on donations from the public to fund its operations, receiving little government support.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: despite vs in spite of
quests.question: The startup managed to secure another round of funding, ___ growing skepticism from investors.
quests.targetSentence: The startup managed to secure another round of funding, in spite of growing skepticism from investors.
quests.grammarRule: Contrast: despite vs in spite of
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In spite of' shows the achievement happened despite an obstacle; 'amid' would only describe the surrounding atmosphere without implying it was overcome.
quests.nativeTip: This shows an achievement overcoming an obstacle, not simply describing the surrounding atmosphere.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in spite of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The startup managed to secure another round of funding, in spite of growing skepticism from investors.'

quests.question: Whatever challenges lie ahead, the team remains confident it can rise ___ the occasion, just as it always has.
quests.targetSentence: Whatever challenges lie ahead, the team remains confident it can rise to the occasion, just as it always has.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Rise to the occasion' is a fixed idiom meaning to perform well under pressure, closing this unit on a confident note.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom meaning to perform well when a difficult moment demands it.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Whatever challenges lie ahead, the team remains confident it can rise to the occasion, just as it always has.'
